EXPLANATION: Two strong C–H stretching bands at 2837 and 2946 cm⁻¹ and a CH₂/CH₃ deformation at 1454 cm⁻¹ are consistent with aliphatic alcohols (GFQ-003). The strong band at 1036 cm⁻¹ matches the typical C–O stretch of methanol (~1020–1050 cm⁻¹). Absence of N–H stretches (~3300 cm⁻¹) disfavors amines (e.g., 2, 8), and candidates with Si–Cl, P=O, nitro, or aromatic motifs would show other characteristic bands not observed. Methanol (SMILES CO) best fits the observed pattern.
